title: security: rbac-v2 KMS region pinning + audit hardening
author: Priya Menon
commits: f3a9c8e: add kms_region metadata to audit events
b7d2a1f: policy evaluator: surface kms_region and residency checks
9c1b4d2: migration: add kms_region column and backfill job
e2ff3a0: add feature flag and rollout gating for enforcement
a1b2c3d: tests: e2e and unit coverage for region pinning logic
description: Motivation: Customers in regulated industries require proving that customer data encrypted with customer-managed KMS keys is bound to a specific cloud region. This PR strengthens RBAC v2 policy checks and audit logging around KMS region pinning, adds a migration and backfill for existing key metadata, and introduces a feature-flagged enforcement path so we can safely roll from audit-only to enforcement. What changed: 1) Policy evaluator now understands two new constraints: kms_region and kms_residency (enum: same-region, cross-region-prohibited). These are expressed as policy predicates and evaluated at authorization time. 2) Audit logs now include structured kms metadata (key_id, key_alias, kms_region, residency_tag) so compliance forwards and SIEMs can assert residency. 3) Migration: SQL migration adds kms_region and residency_tag columns to key_metadata table and includes a background backfill job that sources region from cloud provider metadata when available. 4) KMS client: canonicalize key ARN parsing and expose region resolution helpers used by policy evaluator and audit writer. 5) Feature flagging: deploy/feature_flags.yaml adds rbac_v2.kms_region_enforce which gates the enforcement code path; default staged rollout is false. 6) Tests: unit tests for policy predicates, e2e integration test covering a user request encrypted with a cross-region key when enforcement is off (allowed) and rejected when enforcement is toggled on. Rollout plan: merge to main behind CI, deploy to staging with backfill job, monitor audit logs for anomalies, flip feature flag to gradual enforcement after 1 week of observing no unexpected denies. Related: ENG-2145, SEC-784, SUP-101. Breaking change: none by default (enforcement behind feature flag).

release_notes: Harden RBAC v2 with KMS region pinning checks and richer audit logging. Introduces migration to add KMS region metadata and a feature flag to toggle enforcement. No enforcement by default.
summary: Implements kms_region and kms_residency policy predicates, enriches audit logs with KMS metadata, adds migration/backfill for key metadata, feature-flagged enforcement, and test coverage. Intended to enable compliance teams to assert data residency and to safely roll enforcement into production.
